description: Authoritative OpenCode t0-t8 prompt set for the model-reliability evaluation. The prompt text is frozen; changing it would create a new benchmark version and invalidate direct comparisons with prior runs.
quote_preservation: Each tN.txt stores the recovered text byte-for-byte, including the surrounding literal double-quote characters and with no trailing newline. The SHA-256 values are computed over those exact bytes.

tests.purpose: Smoke / self-identification: name model + cwd, no tools
File/path recovery from a wrong hint; report path + line count
Git accuracy / commit reporting: scoped edit, validate, single commit
Repository/content search for PinPal; exact count + paths
Semantic judgment of the 'asterisks in table cells' claim
No-op discipline: mandatory ordered workflow, no network fetch
Validation / tool discovery: identify + run format:check
Fresh-evidence / provenance: validator twice, separate outputs
Invalid-command recovery from two bogus commands
